summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed(speed) method that scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns styled "progress.percentage" Text, and a render branch that shows speed when the total is None and show_speed is on, using finished_speed or speed. Module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to TaskProgressColumn. Progress.track now infers the total as explicit total, else len() for Sized sequences, else None without raising. Removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Added the CHANGELOG line under Unreleased / Added. Nothing was run (tests, mypy, black), and nothing was committed.
